OPERATING RULES

7. If an existing secret is present but unbound, safely bind it to the correct execution context.
8. Do not weaken, skip, remove, or mark a hard gate optional to obtain a passing certificate.

14. Continue repairing and rerunning until every required gate genuinely passes.
15. If an irreversible credential or signing-key decision is required, stop only that item and report the exact verified blocker. Continue all other safe work.
